summary:
Plan of w204 (supervision r140-r148) at .shop/scratch/2-plan/plan.md. All nine accepted scenarios are red at undefined steps; the r140/r141/r142/r143/r147/r148 code is missing, and r144-r146 already behave.
D1: an apply round that applies nothing says so in a result field of its own, not the status word (r133); an apply with neither questions, a list nor that field still gets the r131 question, the only reading that holds r131, r132 and r147 together.
D2/D3: such an apply writes no question and makes no transition, its stage directory committed; the route reads p1's latest stage result and goes to integrate, with drafted after.
D4-D6: the new integrate round runs in runs/p1/<k>-integrate, p1 keeps its status during it (r143) and moves to drafted at its end, rewritten in place (lists and drafts sentence) with no second proposal (r148); the earlier drafts are untouched.
D7: the proposal's integrate brief gets the initiative's fulfils and accepted lines, its ledger, and the proposal's questions and answers (r141).
Added agents/initiative-round.md; dropped the unchanged modules from the researcher's set. No existing test breaks. Five open cases are left to the implementer.
